optional6: UNUSED no distinct predeclared question, never filled by replacement
task: same6s cruise/reference/terminal across all arms, speed1.8, direction15deg F2 or45deg F4, phase1 read-gate, A/B .36s; source condition differs only between two fixed motion conditions; only gap .55/1.2/2s varies within condition
new_task_relation: historical source path11.79m ->P13 path12.51m, all arms unchanged newtask6s cruise, not exact old reproduction; source_id traces every arm
development_failures: dev5/6/7 retained, not replaced; dev9/10 show stableA/fullB in F2; F4 may have unstable singleA, this is a primary question, not filtered
treatment_estimand: assigned blocked total effect, includes cache/delivery and natural initial differences; fixed phase1, no pure capture-phase claim
covariates: direct COM p/v/H/W and body q/omega

analysis.unit: one flight; one seed block is one correlated11-arm cluster; n3 per condition per arm, not windows/models
analysis.primary: raw paired within-prespecified-block contrasts, individual seeds/range/mean; no significance-as-equivalence or strict same-state causal proof
analysis.initial: all initial covariates and natural differences reported. No after-result exclusion or matching on capture/survival. Sensitivity diagnostics via fixed M3/M4/M5 initial perturbations separate from raw contrasts and not fitted statistical proof
analysis.nonadditivity: all common absolute task0 prefixes; ordered SO3 products R_N*(R_N^T R_A)*(R_N^T R_B); opposite order diagnostic separate. L nonadditive difference AB-A-B+N, initial differences retained
analysis.science_failure: tilt>45 or LP loss>1 task OR; frozen original primary P5 retained. Physical origin/COM L/D/W separate; D never reset, record all prefixes

meaningful_scales.source: P12 prespecified5deg/.2m and P5 .1m/s settle scale, 3 native8ms cycles; not derived from new repair benefits

analysis.censor: NOT_REACHED for events after safety stop; failure witness valid prefix, SUCCESS requires full coverage; UNKNOWN excluded from agreement denominator and always enumerated
analysis.cost: integrals compare AB/repair only common covered window; own fulltask costs separately, no censored/full integral subtraction. TV,joint-square,thrust impulse are mechanical proxies, never electricity
analysis.repair: same capture-only RTDEC2, no formal tuning; initial activation same zero-speed capture; all-arm gate param write identical
analysis.prediction: M3/M4 retained, sole M5 source verticalCOM candidate frozen before dev9; no formal fitting. Blind inputs only past/controller+physical initial, known plan/native nominal range; actual future only scores. Report component tilt/height/OR, fullprefix,Bbeforeerrors, firstcrossing intervals, recovery and cost/UNKNOWN
